content.text: Community members expressed concern about the apparent inactivity of the ElizaOS project and its Discord server. The only visible signs of life noted were GitHub updates. Speculation arose that the silence may be related to ongoing legal proceedings or a deliberate decision to stay quiet until an anticipated app release. Members noted that communication has been declining despite previous promises, and even spam activity in the channel has ceased. A developer posted asking if anyone was looking to hire, suggesting some community members remain engaged despite the low activity.

Discussion in the community channel reflects a largely pessimistic outlook on the future of DEGENAI and ElizaOS. One user noted that AI trading is considered a major trend for the next bull market and expressed hope that DEGENAI could perform well. However, other community members pushed back, suggesting the projects are effectively dead and that most participants have moved on. A point of concern raised was that even shaw, a key figure associated with ElizaOS, no longer posts anything related to the project on his social media. One user cautioned that launching new coins to replace abandoned ones would be counterproductive, as it would erode trust. A separate user named Angelina directed criticism at project leadership, claiming the project's decline began before the bear market due to immature leadership.

In the coders channel, several AI engineers introduced themselves and expressed interest in collaborating on projects involving AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM integrations, multi-agent systems, RAG, MCP, full-stack development, robotics, and game development. One member announced the release of a new skill called Neverbell, which gives AI agents market access, and invited community feedback. Another member shared Cipher Vault, a browser-based GameFi demo running on Solana Devnet that uses an Eliza AI Oracle agent to generate daily riddles. The game involves harvesting in-game currency, paying tributes, and solving puzzles, with all activity settled as on-chain SPL token transfers on Devnet.

Users debated whether the crypto market is currently in a bear or bull market. One user argued it remains a bear market until the top 100 coins by market cap each reach at least 1 billion dollars, referencing conditions seen in late 2020 and mid 2025 as benchmarks. Another countered that crypto now moves in sectors rather than as a whole, pointing to onchain markets on the Robinhood chain as currently experiencing a bull market while majors lag. The discussion noted that past narratives such as AI coins, meme coins, RWA, and the Robinhood chain have each drawn attention in cycles. One user expressed doubt that a broad alt season like 2021 would return, while another insisted alt season is already happening in specific sectors.

In the general discussion channel, a user named Faouzi122 raised a technical question directed at developers building AI agents that allocate capital into liquidity pool positions, asking how they handle impermanent loss calculations and breakeven points before committing funds to a pool, specifically whether they hardcode formulas, use an SDK, or skip the check entirely. Community members also discussed the ai16z DAO, potentially rebranded as Eliza DAO, operating on the Robinhood chain. Partnership inquiries came from Troseddol and Mint from Action Model, with Mint asking how to pursue partnership discussions.

A solo builder operating under the handle agentshare.dev announced they are developing an API-first data platform focused on real-time Solana DeFi intelligence. The platform provides Meteora DLMM pool briefs, bin depth data, and DEX scouting capabilities. The project is described as fully x402-ready, meaning it is designed to support autonomous agents and micro-billing use cases. Separately, a user named NativeSatoshi announced the launch of Coopa v4.0, a data sovereignty platform built on top of Irys for permanent and immutable data storage. The platform offers wallet-based identity, closed-source cryptographic protection, and a feature called Eternal Whispers for sovereign data interaction and messaging. Coopa was temporarily opened to the Irys community for stress-testing and is accessible at coopaassistant.com.
